concept: Route 53 weighted routing: canary / percentage traffic split
tests: Choosing a routing policy for a gradual percentage-based shift to a new version.
expected: Weighted routing — relative weights (10/90) on records with the same name, adjusted over time. Triggers: "10% of users to the new stack", "change the share over time", canary/blue-green.
why_not: Failover is active/passive HA; Geolocation routes by location; Simple is a single record set without weights.
